```plato

// A cubic Bezier arc in space: interpolates P0 to P3, shaped by the interior
// control points P1 and P2 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve).
type CubicBezier3D
    implements ICurve3D, IDeformable3D
{
    P0: Point3D;
    P1: Point3D;
    P2: Point3D;
    P3: Point3D;
}
```
